title: BLEND: Balancing Personalization vs. Generalization in Federated Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.12907v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Federated vision-language models (FedVLMs) represent one of the emerging frontiers of machine learning, aiming to integrate federated learning within the fine-tuning pipelines of vision-language models (VLMs). In this work, we introduce BLEND, a new framework designed to jointly enhance the personalization and generalization capabilities of FedVLMs. BLEND proposes a selective VLM parameter fine-tuning and aggregation strategy that consists of (i) global vision and text adapters shared across clients, and (ii) a personalized vision projection adapter tailored to each client. BLEND further introduces a novel loss function that blends the outputs of the global and personalized adapters to achieve personalization, while simultaneously promoting generalization through a principled anchor design implemented via the projection heads of the zero-shot VLM. translated_title: BLEND：在联邦视觉语言模型中平衡个性化与泛化能力
translated_abstract: 联邦视觉语言模型是机器学习的新兴前沿领域之一，旨在将联邦学习整合到视觉语言模型的微调流程中。在这项工作中，我们提出了BLEND，一个旨在同时增强联邦视觉语言模型个性化与泛化能力的新框架。BLEND提出了一种选择性的VLM参数微调与聚合策略，包含两个部分：(i) 在客户端之间共享的全局视觉和文本适配器，(ii) 为每个客户端量身定制的个性化视觉投影适配器。BLEND进一步引入了一种新颖的损失函数，通过融合全局适配器和个性化适配器的输出来实现个性化，同时通过零样本VLM投影头实现的原理性锚点设计来促进泛化。大量实验表明，BLEND始终优于最先进的基线方法。
tldr: BLEND框架通过结合客户端共享的全局视觉与文本适配器、每个客户端专属的个性化视觉投影适配器，以及融合全局与个性化输出的新型损失函数，在联邦视觉语言模型中同时实现了个性化与泛化能力的提升。
en_tdlr: BLEND is a novel framework that jointly enhances personalization and generalization in federated vision-language models through globally shared vision and text adapters, client-specific personalized projection adapters, and a new loss function that blends global and personalized adapter outputs while anchoring to zero-shot VLM projection heads.
